name: Subflow description
info:
# Insert Queue

Process of this subflow:
 1. queue messages
 2. insert message by message into postgresql node
 3. drop the message from the queue, when it was processed succesfull
 4. peek a new message from the queue
 5. repeat

Each input will be queued inside the q-gate node. (FIFO)
During start of the subflow a Trigger will be activated. This trigger will send a "control: peek" message at a given interval.
This is necessary because when the queue is empty we need to periodically check if a new message is available.
When a message is dequeued the trigger will be deactivated (msg.reset: true) until the message is processed by the postgresql node.
